facts.business: T&I Global Limited is an established manufacturer and exporter of tea-processing machinery, with a growing presence in food and agro-processing equipment, providing turnkey solutions covering design, installation, commissioning and after-sales support.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company expects to consolidate the recovery as export markets stabilise and its food and agro-processing portfolio expands.

key_risks: Revenue concentration and cyclicality, arising from the project-led and export-oriented nature of the business.
Geopolitical and country risk in key export markets, which can affect the timing of order execution.
Volatility in the prices of steel and electrical components, the principal raw materials.
Foreign-exchange risk on export revenues and imported inputs.
Competition and the risk of technological obsolescence.
